_comment: Example semantic-pass receipt (a Verification Summary Attestation). One file per gate, stored at .abcd/work/reviews/<commit-sha>/<gate>.json. The receipt_gate record-lint rule verifies, at release time, that subject.digest.gitCommit matches the target commit, verificationResult is PROMOTE, judgeModel is a pinned snapshot (never a floating alias), and policy.detector names this gate. Once the pinned input manifest (manifest.json) exists in the release's content tree — the era marker — three further PROCEDURAL checks arm: manifestHash must equal manifest.json's actual sha256, which the receipt writer computes at the reviewed commit (`printf 'sha256:'; shasum -a 256 .abcd/development/release-gate/manifest.json | cut -d' ' -f1`) — this example carries a placeholder there, never a literal, because the manifest changes with every surface a branch adds and a literal copy made every two such branches conflict (iss-2610150526192138), and receipt_gate refuses the placeholder like any other mismatch; tier must be sufficient for the release's impact class (a shallow receipt is refused on a feature/breaking release); and every entry in failing must carry a disposition. From manifest schemaVersion 2 that disposition is exactly fixed, invalid or deferred, and a deferred entry also carries "record": "iss-<id>", the open issue record it is captured as, which no other deferred entry of the release names; for example {"where": "04-surfaces/16-lint.md:12", "disposition": "deferred", "record": "iss-2610150900000001"}. The gate never judges a finding's content or severity — confirmed findings route to the maintainer, whose PROMOTE with recorded dispositions is the gate. A missing, mismatched, malformed, HOLD, or model-less receipt fails the release closed. In phase 4 the receipt is cosign-signed and the signature verified in-Go.
manifestHash: sha256:<computed: the sha256 of manifest.json at subject.digest.gitCommit>
